text:
sara: Customer 'AcmeMaps' reports intermittent invalid JSON when using Python SDK streaming in JSON mode. They see JSONDecodeError / "Extra data" when parsing the concatenated stream. Repro attached below. Request id from customer: req_9f3b2a. This started after SDK v0.8.2 deploy. :frowning:

alex: Can you paste the minimal repro (client code + raw bytes) and the SDK version? Also any server request_id/trace headers are helpful. Might be chunk boundary trimming inside our stream parser.

sara: Repro (local) — Python with requests streaming. SDK wrapper behaves similarly. Minimal snippet:
```
import requests
r = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat', json={"json_mode":"json","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"x"}]}, stream=True)
for chunk in r.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True):
    if chunk:
        print(repr(chunk))
```
Raw chunk output we captured from their run (chunks printed in order):
```
'{"id":"msg_1","output":{"parts":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"geo\": {\"lat\": 47.6,\"lon\": -122.3},\"meta\": {\"src\": "acme"}'
', '}, {"type":"map","data":{"tiles":[]}}]}}'
```
The first chunk ends inside a nested JSON string (embedded JSON as a string field), and the split appears to break escape handling so when client concatenates naive chunks we end up with invalid JSON like:
```
{"id":"msg_1","output":{"parts":[{"type":"text","text":"{"geo": {"lat": 47.6,"lon": -122.3},"meta": {"src": "acme"}',}, {"type":"map","data":{"tiles":[]}}]}}
```
which produces "Extra data" or "Expecting ',' delimiter" depending on parser.

michael: This looks like a framing/escaping mismatch between server-side streaming serializer and client-side ndjson/json-lines expectation. If server flushes in the middle of an already-escaped quoted string we can break naive line-delimited parsing. We saw a related issue in TS streaming parser but fixed in a PR that properly escapes/encodes embedded JSON payloads before chunking.

alex: SDK version? Also whether customer uses `json_mode='json'` vs `json_mode='ndjson'` or the new `structured_output` flag.

sara: They were using python-sdk 0.8.2 via our high-level client with structured_output=True (maps to json_mode='json' in transport). I reproduced locally with requests too. I also tried toggling `enable_streaming=False` and that avoids the problem (full-body works). Repro request id on our side: req_9f3b2a. Attached server-side logs show flushing frames around 00:12:45 UTC.

michael: Immediate workaround for customers: disable streaming or set the client to treat frames strictly as ndjson (i.e., request `Content-Frame-Type: ndjson` if using raw HTTP). For SDKs: we should harden the streaming parser to handle mid-string chunk splits by accumulating until a valid JSON object boundary is observed (not just newline). Also we need to ensure server escapes newlines inside JSON string fields or uses length-prefix framing.

alex: I think this is an SDK+runtime coordination bug. There's an in-flight change on the runtime side to switch to length-prefix frames for structured outputs (RW-issue 2107) but not yet deployed. On SDK side we have a half-complete fix in branch `fix/stream-streaming-escape` that buffers and attempts incremental parse. I'll open an internal tracking ticket and link both teams.

sara: Customer asked for ETA. Can we do a hotfix or recommend a config change? They can't disable streaming easily because they rely on low latency.

michael: Short-term: recommend `structured_output: false` or set `max_frame_size` to 64k on the runtime policy (if they control dedicated/private) to reduce mid-string flushes. For hosted customers, recommend toggling to the non-streaming endpoint or we can enable our experimental `escape-embedded-json` flag per-customer — I'll check with runtime.

alex: I'll create internal bug RW-4732, assign to eng-runtime and sdk-python. We'll add labels: severity=medium, component=streaming-parser, reproduce=req_9f3b2a. Work items: (1) collect full packet capture from customer, (2) enable the runtime feature flip for AcmeMaps, (3) land the SDK buffer parser fix, (4) release patch 0.8.3.

sara: Created support ticket for customer with explanation and workaround suggestions. I'll escalate to account team and set expectation of 72h for a proper fix. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Created issue RW-4732 in internal tracker and assigned to @eng-runtime, @sdk-python. (link: https://internal.redwood/issue/RW-4732)

alex: Thanks. Please add any additional logs (raw bytes, base64 if needed) to RW-4732. I'll sync with runtime tomorrow morning.
